_note: Team settings. These cutoffs are policy choices made by the team, not computed by the app or chosen by AI. Change them here.
underrepresented_ratio_note: A tract is under-represented when its share of located comments is below this fraction of its share of residents.
policy_sections_note: Stance (support/oppose/neutral) is shown only for these sections, where comments take a position on a proposal or agenda item. Streets, sanitation, public safety, code enforcement and other are mostly reports and requests, so their comments show as 'Report or request' with no stance.
small_n_note: Ratios computed from fewer comments than this are shown with a 'small sample' warning.
underheard_rule_note: A census tract is underheard only if it sends under underrepresented_ratio of its population share of comments AND either reports 311 problems at or above problems_vs_city times the city rate, or has limited-English households at or above limited_english_vs_city times the city share. Few comments with few problems and normal factors counts as quiet, not underheard. Sections without 311 data use the limited-English test only.
